rationale: This is a cosmetic variant of the archived "Persistent R&D Cash-Flow Floor" (same MA-R&D × 5-year-minimum-profitability template, merely swapping oancf/at for the already-tested ib+xrd addback from "R&D-Addback Liability Power"), so it is unlikely to deliver independent evidence.

The "distance above own five-year trough" recovery construct is a genuinely different state variable from the archived level/floor and delta formulations, though it is mechanically correlated with the current oancf level and reuses the che/lct leg already tested twice, so incremental information may be modest.

Economically identical to the archived "Goodwill Equity-Cushion Cash Burn" (goodwill load × weak equity × operating cash burn), differing only in decomposing the goodwill/(goodwill+ceq) ratio into a SUMRANK of its two components — a purely cosmetic reformulation.

Direct rediscovery of the archived "Capitalized Intangible Turnover Stress" with TS_RANK replaced by TREND on the same sale/at series and the identical NEG(oancf/lt) leg, which is an operator swap rather than a new mechanism.

A coherent and economically distinct test — using cash tax burden to separate value-creating acquisitions from impairment-prone goodwill, and notably inverting the archive's uniformly negative goodwill priors — though it is structurally the archived "Tax-Paying R&D Solvency" with the intangible leg swapped and is a very simple two-rank product.

This is the sign-flipped mirror of the archived "Knowledge Working-Capital Stability" (same MA R&D intensity × working-capital volatility), with only a bolted-on lct/lt current-liability-share leg, so it re-tests an already-measured relationship rather than a new hypothesis.
